scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run dev:web:raw
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run dev:backend:raw
scripts.dev:schema-sync-service: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run dev:schema-sync-service:raw
scripts.dev:full: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && concurrently -n core,web,api,sync -c magenta,blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev:web:raw" "npm run dev:backend:raw" "npm run dev:schema-sync-service:raw"
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run build:backend && npm run build:schema-sync-service
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run build -w @schemadash/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run build -w @schemadash/backend
scripts.build:schema-sync-service: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-service
scripts.build:server: npm run build:backend && npm run build:schema-sync-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run typecheck -w @schemadash/frontend && npm run typecheck -w @schemadash/backend && npm run typecheck -w @schemadash/schema-sync-service
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:core && npm run test:backend && npm run test:schema-sync-service
scripts.test:web: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run test -w @schemadash/frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run test -w @schemadash/backend
scripts.test:schema-sync-service: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run test -w @schemadash/schema-sync-service
scripts.test:server: npm run test:backend && npm run test:schema-sync-service
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:web:ci && npm run test:core:ci && npm run test:backend:ci && npm run test:schema-sync-service:ci
scripts.test:web:ci: npm run build -w @schemadash/schema-sync-core && npm run test:ci -w @schemadash/frontend
scripts.test:server:ci: npm run test:backend:ci && npm run test:schema-sync-service:ci
